boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Mary's College of California
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with directly verified evening availability in Moraga, on campus, or nearby Lamorinda.

cards.title: Oliver Hall Late Night
cards.subtitle: Saint Mary's College campus, Moraga
cards.notes: Check the dining-hours page before leaving; the listed academic-year late-night window runs 9–11 p.m. on designated nights.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus dining hall has a documented late-night program.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists Oliver Hall late-night dining from 9:00–11:00 p.m. on Sunday through Thursday during the academic-year schedule.
cards.source_title: Dining Hours | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Academic-year schedule lists Late Night 9:00–11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; the page says hours may change during breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Café Louis Evening Stop
cards.subtitle: Saint Mary's College campus, Moraga
cards.notes: Use the posted schedule to time an evening coffee or snack run; verify holiday and break adjustments before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop with documented weekday evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's dining information lists Café Louis open until 9:00 p.m. Monday through Friday during the cited academic-year schedule.
cards.source_title: Dining Hours | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: The posted schedule lists Monday–Friday hours until 9:00 p.m.; verify changes during break periods or holidays.

cards.entity_name: JustBaked machine at De La Salle Hall
cards.title: JustBaked at De La Salle
cards.subtitle: Ground floor of De La Salle Hall, Saint Mary's campus
cards.notes: Keep this automated campus option in mind when staffed locations are closed; use available Flex Dollars or another accepted payment method.
cards.short_summary: A documented 24/7 hot-food machine on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: A Saint Mary's family newsletter states that the JustBaked machine on De La Salle's ground floor provides hot food options 24/7.
cards.source_title: Saint Mary's College Family Newsletter — December 2025
cards.access_notes: The College newsletter describes the JustBaked machine as providing hot-food options 24/7.

cards.title: Nation's Moraga Until 10
cards.subtitle: 400 Park Street, Moraga
cards.notes: Confirm the daily listing before making the trip; the restaurant’s location page currently posts service through 10 p.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Moraga food stop with a directly posted 10 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Nation's official locations page lists its Moraga restaurant at 400 Park Street as open daily from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Find a Nation's | Nation’s Giant Hamburgers
cards.access_notes: Official location listing: daily 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Round Table on Rheem
cards.subtitle: 361 Rheem Boulevard, Moraga
cards.notes: For the latest Friday or Saturday pickup window, select the Moraga location in the official ordering page before you set out.
cards.short_summary: A Moraga pizza counter whose official ordering page posts 10 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Round Table's Moraga ordering page lists Friday and Saturday open hours until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Round Table Pizza — Moraga ordering
cards.access_notes: Official ordering page lists Friday 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. and Saturday 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Nation's Orinda Late Window
cards.subtitle: 65 Moraga Way, Orinda
cards.notes: Check the day before traveling from campus: this location’s official listing shows a later close than the Moraga location on every day.
cards.short_summary: An Orinda food destination with posted service through 11 p.m. or midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Nation's official locations page lists the Orinda restaurant open until 11 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and midnight Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Find a Nation's | Nation’s Giant Hamburgers
cards.access_notes: Official location listing: Sun–Wed 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; Thu–Sat 6:00 a.m.–12:00 a.m.

cards.title: Casa Orinda Friday or Saturday
cards.subtitle: 20 Bryant Way, Orinda
cards.notes: Plan this as a Friday or Saturday dinner destination and use the restaurant’s current-hours page to confirm the 10 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A long-running Orinda restaurant with directly posted late-week dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Orinda's official site lists Friday and Saturday hours from 4:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Casa Orinda Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday 4:00–10:00 p.m.; Wednesday, Thursday, and Sunday end at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Metro's 11 p.m. Dining Window
cards.subtitle: 3524 Mt. Diablo Boulevard, Lafayette
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s hours page for same-day confirmation; it lists dining every day through 11 p.m., separate from its bar information.
cards.short_summary: A Lafayette restaurant with an official daily 11 p.m. dining listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Metro Lafayette's official hours page says the restaurant is open seven days a week from 11:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Metro Lafayette — Hours and Reservations
cards.access_notes: Official hours page lists restaurant dining 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. daily; confirm holiday exceptions on that page.

cards.title: Fourth Bore Weekend Dinner
cards.subtitle: 2 Theatre Square, Orinda
cards.notes: Visit for food during the posted Friday or Saturday window, and check the venue’s hours page before departure for schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: An Orinda grill with officially posted 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Fourth Bore's official site lists Friday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and Saturday hours of 10 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Fourth Bore
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday closing at 10:00 p.m.; weekday and Sunday hours end at 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Rancho Cantina's 9:30 Close
cards.subtitle: 3616 Mt. Diablo Boulevard, Lafayette
cards.notes: Use the direct restaurant site to check its current Friday and Saturday schedule before arranging an evening meal near downtown Lafayette.
cards.short_summary: A Lafayette restaurant with a published 9:30 p.m. late-week close.
cards.evidence_claim: Rancho Cantina's official site lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11:30 a.m. to 9:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Rancho Cantina
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday–Saturday 11:30 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday hours end at 8:30 p.m.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus destinations for studying, making, gathering, moving, reflecting, and taking part in College life.

cards.title: The Power Plant Interim Library
cards.subtitle: Temporary library location during Saint Albert Hall modernization
cards.notes: Start here for the service desk, technology checkout, course reserves, browsing collection, and study rooms while the main library is closed.
cards.short_summary: A practical academic stop with library services and study rooms in the Power Plant.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that interim library services in the Power Plant include a service desk, technology checkout, course reserves, study rooms, and a browsing collection.
cards.source_title: A New Chapter for Our Library
cards.access_notes: Saint Albert Hall is closed for modernization; library services are temporarily in the Power Plant. Check the library site for service details.

cards.title: The Student Media Center in Sichel Hall
cards.subtitle: Study lounge and hybrid screening/editing lab
cards.notes: Bring a project or a classmate and use the lounge’s screening and editing setup; the College identifies the space as available to all students.
cards.short_summary: A named Sichel Hall lounge for studying, screening, and editing work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Student Media Center in Sichel Hall as a study lounge and hybrid screening/editing lab available to all students.
cards.source_title: LGBTQIA Resources
cards.access_notes: The College says the space is available to all students; confirm any equipment or room-use procedures before planning a session.

cards.title: The Intercultural Center at Delphine Lounge
cards.subtitle: Between the bookstore and Café Louis on Ferroggiaro Quad
cards.notes: Check the IC calendar or drop into its programs and services to connect around identity, cultural learning, student leadership, and social justice.
cards.short_summary: A Delphine Lounge-based center for co-curricular programs and inclusive community building.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says the Intercultural Center is located in Delphine Lounge and provides programs and services that foster cultural competence, social justice, and belonging.
cards.source_title: About Us | Intercultural Center
cards.access_notes: Located along Ferroggiaro Quad between the bookstore and Café Louis; consult the IC calendar for scheduled programs.

cards.title: The Alioto Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus recreation, fitness, courts, pool, and climbing wall
cards.notes: Complete the required waiver, then choose a workout, court activity, swim, climbing session, or fitness class that fits your day.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility built for exercise, socializing, and learning new activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says currently enrolled students have access to the Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center, which includes fitness equipment, courts, pool, climbing wall, and class rooms.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled SMC students have access; incoming students must complete the facility waiver. Check the facility calendar and current hours.

cards.title: Café Louis and Ferroggiaro Quad
cards.subtitle: Coffee shop with seating inside and outdoors by the quad
cards.notes: Use the café as a meet-up point, then take food or a drink to the indoor seating or the outdoor tables beside Ferroggiaro Quad.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop whose seating extends to the adjacent quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Café Louis as a coffee shop and states that meals may be enjoyed inside the café or outdoors in Ferroggiaro Quad.
cards.source_title: Catering and Food Services
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks are sold; check the College dining page for current operating hours and offerings.

cards.title: Oliver Hall
cards.subtitle: Main student dining hall
cards.notes: Meet over a meal and use the published dining information to plan around the hall’s food stations and dietary-support options.
cards.short_summary: The College’s main student dining hall, with a range of food options.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Oliver Hall as the main dining hall available to students and notes its variety of food options and Clean Plates station.
cards.source_title: Dining Hours
cards.access_notes: Dining requires a meal plan, points, or another form of payment as applicable. Verify current hours and service details before going.

cards.title: The Legacy Garden
cards.subtitle: Half-acre campus garden beside Claeys South
cards.notes: Join posted volunteer hours or workshops, or take a slow loop through the garden; email Sustainability for ways to participate.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor educational garden with volunteer work, workshops, and community growing.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Legacy Garden as a half-acre living laboratory and outdoor educational space where students contribute service hours; everyone is welcome to work in and enjoy it.
cards.source_title: Legacy Garden
cards.access_notes: The garden is entered through the South Claeys Residential Hall parking lot. Contact Sustainability for upcoming volunteer hours.

cards.title: Chapel Lawn
cards.subtitle: The lawn directly in front of Saint Mary’s Chapel
cards.notes: Bring a blanket for a quiet outdoor pause, then check the campus calendar for lawn-based community programs and scheduled events.
cards.short_summary: A prominent lawn outside the Chapel that also hosts College gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Chapel Lawn as the space in front of the Chapel and lists campus community events held there.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Worship Spaces
cards.access_notes: Outdoor availability can vary with College events and reservations; use posted guidance and respect any event setup.

cards.title: Cassin Student Union
cards.subtitle: Student-union destination on the campus map
cards.notes: Use the union as a central meeting landmark, and pair a stop there with the nearby Intercultural Center, Café Louis, and Ferroggiaro Quad.
cards.short_summary: A named student-union destination clustered with several student-facing campus spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s current campus map lists Cassin Student Union as a campus destination, and the College’s worship-spaces page identifies its fountain area.
cards.source_title: On-Campus Worship Spaces
cards.access_notes: Check campus signage and scheduling information for any room-specific access or event restrictions.

cards.title: Claeys Lounge in the Soda Activity Center
cards.subtitle: Soda Activity Center event and gathering space
cards.notes: Look for College programs using Claeys Lounge, then plan it as a clear indoor meeting point when attending a scheduled event or celebration.
cards.short_summary: A named Soda Activity Center lounge used for College programs and celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s 2026 Commencement schedule lists Claeys Lounge as the location for College graduate celebrations, and the current campus map lists it in the Soda Activity Center.
cards.source_title: 2026 Commencement Schedule
cards.access_notes: Use the College events calendar for public programs; room availability may be limited by scheduled functions.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-additional-purchase ways for currently enrolled Gaels to spend time together, using student facility access or unreserved public park amenities.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Swimming Pool
cards.title: Meet at the JARC pool
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring your SMC ID and meet friends for a swim or poolside reset. Check the facility calendar before heading over, since access requires student eligibility.
cards.short_summary: A campus pool hang using enrolled-student recreation-center access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a swimming pool among JARC amenities and states that all students currently enrolled in SMC classes have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; facility policies require a current waiver and check-in.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Climbing Wall
cards.title: Try the JARC climbing wall
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Plan a climbing session with a friend and follow the wall’s certification and safety requirements. Confirm availability and any required check-in before you go.
cards.short_summary: A supervised indoor climbing option within student facility access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a climbing wall among JARC amenities and states that all students currently enrolled in SMC classes have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; comply with climbing-wall policies and any certification requirements.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Double Gymnasium
cards.title: Set up a gym-court session
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Coordinate a casual basketball, volleyball, badminton, or indoor-soccer session when the double gym is available. Review the facility calendar before gathering a group.
cards.short_summary: Multiple court sports fit in the JARC double gymnasium.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's identifies the JARC double gymnasium for basketball, volleyball, indoor soccer, and badminton; all currently enrolled SMC students have facility access.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; court availability can vary, so consult the facility calendar.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Functional Training Room
cards.title: Train together in the functional room
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Make a simple partner workout plan and use the functional training room during open access. Keep the session within posted rules and share equipment considerately.
cards.short_summary: A flexible indoor workout space for a low-key training meet-up.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a functional training room among JARC amenities and says all currently enrolled SMC students have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; check in and follow JARC facility rules.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Group Exercise Room
cards.title: Move in the group exercise room
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use an available group exercise room for stretching or a low-impact movement break with friends. Confirm room availability through the facility calendar before arriving.
cards.short_summary: An indoor space suited to shared movement and stretching.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a group exercise room among JARC amenities and says all currently enrolled SMC students have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; availability may be affected by scheduled programming.

cards.entity_name: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center Fitness Area
cards.title: Do a fitness-area check-in
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Meet for a self-paced cardio or strength session, then cool down together. Bring your SMC ID, check in at the desk, and follow posted equipment guidance.
cards.short_summary: A student-accessible campus fitness hang with cardio and strength equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's describes a 13,800-square-foot JARC fitness area and says all currently enrolled SMC students have access to the facility.
cards.source_title: About the Facility | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled SMC students; check in at JARC and follow facility policies.

cards.title: Play a round at Moraga Commons
cards.subtitle: Moraga Commons Park, 1425 St. Mary's Road
cards.notes: Bring discs if you have them and play the course at your own pace. Use the park’s availability information and give reserved areas priority to permit holders.
cards.short_summary: A public-park disc-golf outing near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Moraga lists a disc golf course at Moraga Commons Park and says areas not reserved are available first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Moraga Commons Park | Moraga, CA
cards.access_notes: Use only unreserved areas; park hours are one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.

cards.title: Roll a bocce game at the Commons
cards.subtitle: Moraga Commons Park, 1425 St. Mary's Road
cards.notes: Gather a small group for a relaxed bocce game at an unreserved area. Check availability first and leave the space ready for the next park visitors.
cards.short_summary: A casual public-park game with first-come access when unreserved.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Moraga lists bocce ball at Moraga Commons Park and says areas not reserved are available first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Moraga Commons Park | Moraga, CA
cards.access_notes: Use only when not reserved; park hours are one hour before sunrise to one hour after sunset.

cards.title: Meet at Lamorinda Skatepark
cards.subtitle: Moraga Commons Park, 1425 St. Mary's Road
cards.notes: Bring your board, skates, or scooter and use the park during posted hours. Follow all onsite signs and make room for other riders using the facility.
cards.short_summary: A named Moraga Commons skatepark with posted daily access hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town of Moraga identifies Lamorinda Skatepark at Moraga Commons Park and states that it is open from 9 AM to dusk.
cards.source_title: Moraga Commons Park | Moraga, CA
cards.access_notes: Open 9 AM to dusk; follow all posted signage.

cards.entity_name: Moraga for Monarchs Habitat and Demonstration Garden
cards.title: Read the Monarch Garden signs
cards.subtitle: Rancho Laguna Park, Moraga
cards.notes: Walk the garden path slowly, read the plant identification and interpretive signs, and look for pollinators without disturbing them. Keep to designated public areas.
cards.short_summary: A civic pollinator garden with artwork, benches, and interpretive signage.
cards.evidence_claim: A Town of Moraga proclamation documents the Moraga for Monarchs Habitat and Demonstration Garden at Rancho Laguna Park, including benches, plant identification, and interpretive signage.
cards.source_title: Town of Moraga Proclamation Honoring Moraga Garden Club
cards.access_notes: Visit during Rancho Laguna Park’s general-use hours and respect plantings, wildlife, and posted rules.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Saint Mary’s study environments, including the interim library and academic spaces with clear use details.

cards.title: Power Plant Drop-In Space
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Use the lobby’s lounge seats for a flexible solo work session; confirm the interim library’s current opening hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A limited, informal study area inside the College’s temporary library hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that limited drop-in study space is available in the Power Plant, including lounge seats in the lobby.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: The Power Plant library is open only to current SMC students, staff, and faculty; check the Library Hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Power Plant Silent Study Zone
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Choose an individual cubicle in this designated silent room when you need focused reading or writing with fewer distractions.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Power Plant room with individual cubicle workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The College identifies a Silent Study Zone room in the Power Plant with several individual cubicle spaces.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current SMC students, staff, and faculty; visit during published interim library hours.

cards.title: Power Plant Sensory Room
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Reserve this room in advance if a lower-stimulation setup and soft seating would help you reset before returning to coursework.
cards.short_summary: A reservable sensory-focused room within the interim library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s Library lists a sensory room among the reservable spaces in the Power Plant.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: Reserve online up to one week ahead; the interim library is limited to current SMC students, staff, and faculty.

cards.title: Power Plant Reservable Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Interim library near Brousseau Hall
cards.notes: Book one of the library’s four study rooms online up to a week ahead when your group needs a defined place to work.
cards.short_summary: Four bookable group-work rooms in the temporary library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library has four reservable study rooms in the Power Plant, with online reservations available up to a week in advance.
cards.source_title: Library Services and Support at the Power Plant
cards.access_notes: Online reservation is required; interim library access is for current SMC students, staff, and faculty.

cards.entity_name: Marie Curie STEM Center Main Study Room
cards.title: Marie Curie STEM Center Main Study Room
cards.subtitle: Marie Curie STEM Center
cards.notes: Bring a problem set or tutoring question and use the whiteboard tables for collaborative STEM work or one-to-one tutoring.
cards.short_summary: A STEM-focused room set up with whiteboard tables and academic support.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says the Marie Curie STEM Center’s main study room has whiteboard tables for small groups and one-to-one tutoring.
cards.source_title: Science Facilities
cards.access_notes: The Center offers STEM peer tutoring during its listed tutoring hours; verify the current schedule before going.

cards.entity_name: Marie Curie STEM Center Small-Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Marie Curie STEM Center Small-Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Marie Curie STEM Center
cards.notes: Use the SMART-equipped small-group rooms to share material with a project team, then check current tutoring-hour availability before arrival.
cards.short_summary: Two small-group spaces equipped with SMART technology.
cards.evidence_claim: The Marie Curie STEM Center has two small-group study rooms equipped with SMART technology.
cards.source_title: Science Facilities
cards.access_notes: Students may access Center resources during tutoring hours; confirm availability with the STEM Center.

cards.title: Psychology Center Central Lounge
cards.subtitle: Psychology Center
cards.notes: Set up at a couch or table in the central lounge for reading or a quiet partner session, while keeping the academic setting in mind.
cards.short_summary: A lounge with couches and tables at the center of the Psychology Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Psychology Center’s central lounge as having couches and tables where students gather to study and socialize.
cards.source_title: Science Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located in an academic department building; access may vary with building hours and College operations.

cards.title: Galileo Hall Student Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Galileo Hall
cards.notes: Look for the physics, math, and computer science study areas in Galileo Hall when working near those disciplines or meeting classmates.
cards.short_summary: Academic study areas in a science building that also houses classrooms and physics labs.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s says Galileo Hall has student communities and study spaces for physics, math, and computer science students.
cards.source_title: Science Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located in Galileo Hall; use is subject to building access and any department-space policies.

cards.title: Math Pedagogy Center
cards.subtitle: Galileo Hall
cards.notes: Use this Galileo Hall study destination when preparing math coursework, and check with the department if you need program-specific assistance.
cards.short_summary: A named mathematics learning space within Galileo Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s lists the Math Pedagogy Center among Galileo Hall’s physics, math, and computer science student study spaces.
cards.source_title: Science Facilities
cards.access_notes: Located in Galileo Hall; verify building access and Center availability before visiting.

cards.title: Aquinas Hall Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Aquinas Hall Honors Living Community
cards.notes: If you live in the Honors Living Community, use the first-floor study lounge for a close-to-home work session between classes.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor study lounge in the Honors Living Community residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies a study lounge on the first floor of Aquinas Hall, home to the Honors Living Community.
cards.source_title: Honors Living Learning Community
cards.access_notes: This is a residential facility serving the Honors Living Community; access is limited to authorized residents and guests.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along Moraga’s nearby corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Moraga Commons Park: multi-use amenities
cards.subtitle: St. Mary’s Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk the perimeter and choose an amenity that suits the visit; the Town lists a bandshell, disc golf, picnic areas, playgrounds, skatepark, and splash feature.
cards.short_summary: A central park with several documented recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town identifies Moraga Commons as a 40.2-acre multi-use park at 1425 St. Mary’s Road and lists its amenities.
cards.source_title: Moraga Commons Park | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: Town parks open one hour before sunrise and close one hour after sunset.

cards.title: Moraga Library: reading and meeting space
cards.subtitle: St. Mary’s Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring a book or use the library’s public facilities; confirm the day’s opening time before heading over, since the posted schedule varies by day.
cards.short_summary: A county-library stop with a meeting room and accessibility resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Contra Costa County Library lists Moraga Library at 1500 St. Mary’s Road and identifies a meeting room and assistive-technology features.
cards.source_title: Moraga | Contra Costa County Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s posted hours before visiting.

cards.title: Moraga Center: pedestrian-oriented core
cards.subtitle: Moraga Road and Moraga Way corridor
cards.notes: Use the area as a walking-oriented connector between nearby destinations; the Town’s adopted plan describes commercial and recreational activity within this 187-acre area.
cards.short_summary: A named planning district around the town’s commercial core.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town describes the 187-acre Moraga Center Specific Plan area as providing opportunities for commercial and recreational activity.
cards.source_title: Moraga Center Specific Plan Implementation Project | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: This is a district rather than a single venue; follow normal pedestrian and roadway rules.

cards.title: Moraga Shopping Center: retail-core landmark
cards.subtitle: Moraga Road corridor
cards.notes: Use this named commercial-center landmark to orient a walk through Moraga Center, then choose any open business that fits your plans and budget.
cards.short_summary: A shopping center included in the Town’s Moraga Center planning area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town’s housing document describes Moraga Center around Moraga Road and Moraga Way and states that it includes the Moraga Shopping Center.
cards.source_title: Moraga 2023–2031 Housing Element | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours and purchase requirements.

cards.title: West Commons Park: public-art meadow
cards.subtitle: Moraga Road corridor
cards.notes: Take the walking trail through the meadow and pause to view the public art; the Town describes the park as immediately west of Commons Park.
cards.short_summary: A small neighborhood park combining a meadow, art, trail, and picnic area.
cards.evidence_claim: Moraga’s General Plan identifies West Commons on the west side of Moraga Road and lists its public-art meadow, picnic area, and walking trail.
cards.source_title: Moraga General Plan 2040 | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: Use designated paths and observe posted park rules.

cards.title: Hacienda de las Flores: historic grounds
cards.subtitle: Donald Drive corridor
cards.notes: Walk the landscaped grounds and view the historic facilities from public areas; check the Town calendar first because parts of the site may be reserved.
cards.short_summary: A Town facility with historic buildings, lawn, and landscaped grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town describes Hacienda de las Flores as having four historic facilities, a great lawn, and landscaped grounds at 2100 Donald Drive.
cards.source_title: Facility Rentals | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: Reserved facilities require advance arrangements; check availability with Town Parks and Recreation.

cards.title: Mulholland Ridge: ridge-trail views
cards.subtitle: Donald Drive corridor
cards.notes: Start from Donald Drive and stay on the ridge trails for a viewpoint-oriented walk; bring water and follow the Town’s posted trail and dog rules.
cards.short_summary: A 260-acre preserve with trails connecting toward Hacienda and Orinda.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town identifies Mulholland Ridge Open Space Preserve as a 260-acre park atop Donald Drive with ridge trails connecting to Hacienda de las Flores and Orinda trails.
cards.source_title: Mulholland Ridge Open Space Preserve | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: Dogs are off-leash only on the paved portion; they must be leashed on unpaved portions.

cards.title: Rancho Laguna Park: pollinator garden
cards.subtitle: Camino Pablo corridor
cards.notes: Look for the Monarch and Pollinator Habitat and read its interpretive signage; visiting during spring through fall aligns with the Town’s stated bloom period.
cards.short_summary: A park with a documented native and drought-tolerant pollinator garden.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town states that Rancho Laguna Park contains a 2,600-square-foot Monarch and Pollinator Habitat and Demonstration Garden with over 600 plants.
cards.source_title: Rancho Laguna Park | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: The Town lists the park at 2101 Camino Pablo and posts seasonal off-leash rules separately.

cards.title: Rheem Valley Shopping Center: everyday services
cards.subtitle: Moraga Road and Center Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the center as a practical errand stop and confirm individual storefront hours before going; the Town identifies retail, restaurant, and service uses on site.
cards.short_summary: A named commercial center with documented retail and service tenants.
cards.evidence_claim: A Town planning record describes Rheem Valley Shopping Center as a commercial center with retail, restaurant, and service uses, including its Center Street frontage.
cards.source_title: Rheem Valley Shopping Center Public Hearing Record | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Lafayette-Moraga Regional Trail: multi-use route
cards.subtitle: Moraga Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the Town’s trail map to choose a legal access point, then walk or ride at a pace suited to shared use and changing trail conditions.
cards.short_summary: A named regional-trail route shown on the Town’s Moraga trails map.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town’s trails page links to the Lafayette/Moraga Regional Trail, and its official trail map labels the Lafayette–Moraga Trail through Moraga.
cards.source_title: Trails | Town of Moraga
cards.access_notes: The Town trail map states that trails open one hour before sunrise and close one hour after sunset.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Saint Mary’s traditions, from hands-only hillside painting to campus celebrations shaped by Lasallian heritage and student initiative.

cards.title: Paint the SMC Letters
cards.subtitle: Weekend of Welcome hillside tradition
cards.notes: Join the Weekend of Welcome hike to the large SMC letters and paint with your hands—brushes are expressly left behind.
cards.short_summary: New Gaels put fresh color on the campus-facing hillside letters by hand.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s identifies Paint the SMC as a longtime tradition in which students hike uphill and use only their hands to paint the SMC letters.
cards.source_title: All We Can Say Is WoW!
cards.access_notes: Part of Weekend of Welcome programming for new students; confirm the current schedule with Student Life.

cards.title: Weekend of Welcome Pool Party
cards.subtitle: Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring swim-ready gear for the first-year pool gathering, where Campus Recreation pairs giant floats and games with club-sport introductions.
cards.short_summary: An annual first-year pool gathering during Saint Mary’s Weekend of Welcome.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s calls the Pool Party at the Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center an annual Weekend of Welcome tradition for first-year students.
cards.source_title: Welcome to the Gael Life: Poolside Edition
cards.access_notes: For first-year students during Weekend of Welcome; participation details vary by year.

cards.entity_name: Weekend of Welcome Belly Flop Contest
cards.title: The Red-Belly Belly Flop
cards.subtitle: Pool Party contest at Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: If the current Pool Party schedule includes it, watch or enter the belly-flop contest and expect applause for the participant’s red belly.
cards.short_summary: A documented contest embedded in Saint Mary’s annual first-year Pool Party.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes the Pool Party’s Belly Flop Contest as legendary and says contestants receive applause and a red belly.
cards.source_title: Welcome to the Gael Life: Poolside Edition
cards.access_notes: Check the current Weekend of Welcome itinerary; activity is a pool-program feature.

cards.title: Welcome Back Barbecue
cards.subtitle: Weekend of Welcome Sunday evening
cards.notes: Use the Sunday evening barbecue to reconnect after Bay Area trips and meet returning students before the first day of classes.
cards.short_summary: A recurring end-of-Welcome weekend gathering for new and returning Gaels.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Welcome Back Barbecue as an annual Sunday-evening event for new and returning students.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome: See Why This Saint Mary’s Experience Is Like No Other
cards.access_notes: Held during Weekend of Welcome; review the current Student Life schedule for location and eligibility.

cards.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe Week
cards.subtitle: Campus-wide December celebration
cards.notes: Follow the week’s public program, which culminates in a mariachi-led procession, Chapel Mass, and community fiesta in the Soda Center.
cards.short_summary: A student-shaped Saint Mary’s celebration of La Virgen that combines cultural and spiritual events.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s documents its week-long Our Lady of Guadalupe celebration as a campus tradition, culminating in an annual procession, Mass, and fiesta.
cards.source_title: Celebrating Our Lady of Guadalupe
cards.access_notes: Typically held before the end of the fall term; check the current Mission and Ministry calendar.

cards.title: Lasallian Heritage Days
cards.subtitle: Annual April mission celebration
cards.notes: Look for the Heritage Days calendar and choose an open event, from the campus kickoff to mission-focused programs and community activities.
cards.short_summary: An annual Saint Mary’s observance of the Lasallian educational mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s states that Lasallian Heritage Days has been an annual tradition since 2005 honoring Saint John Baptist de La Salle and the Lasallian mission.
cards.source_title: Celebrate Saint Mary’s Lasallian Heritage Days
cards.access_notes: Programming and dates change annually; consult the Office of Mission’s current event listing.

cards.title: 44 Days of Black History
cards.subtitle: Black Leadership Coalition campus celebration
cards.notes: Attend a listed talk, workshop, or cultural event during the 44-day program, organized with campus and community partners.
cards.short_summary: Saint Mary’s extended celebration of Black history, scholarship, culture, and excellence.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s calls 44 Days its signature celebration of Black history and identifies the 2023 program as the sixth annual celebration.
cards.source_title: Get Ready for 44 Days, Saint Mary’s Signature Celebration of Black History
cards.access_notes: Dates, theme, and public events vary; consult the current campus events calendar.

cards.title: January Term, Born from the Moraga Manifesto
cards.subtitle: Four-week January academic session
cards.notes: Explore the current January course list for a concentrated one-class experience, on campus or through an approved travel course.
cards.short_summary: A signature January academic session originating in Saint Mary’s student-led reforms.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s documents January Term as an annual tradition initiated after student activists’ Moraga Manifesto reforms, with its first term in 1970.
cards.source_title: Why Does Jan Term Exist? The Answer Will Surprise You.
cards.access_notes: Enrollment, course availability, and any travel costs depend on the current academic-year offerings.

cards.entity_name: Saint Mary’s Student Research and Creative Works Conference
cards.title: Research and Creative Works Conference
cards.subtitle: Annual student showcase
cards.notes: Visit the conference to see student posters and creative work, or apply through the current academic process to present your own project.
cards.short_summary: A newer annual gathering that places student scholarship and creative work before the wider SMC community.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s describes the Student Research and Creative Works Conference as a new annual tradition bringing the entire community together to showcase student work.
cards.source_title: Is the Honors Program Saint Mary’s Best Kept Secret? Not Anymore.
cards.access_notes: Conference timing, visitor access, and presenter requirements are set each academic year.

cards.title: Grad Grounds Traditions
cards.subtitle: Undergraduate Commencement campus celebrations
cards.notes: After Commencement, join your graduates and guests at the designated grounds celebrations for food, music, photos, and congratulations.
cards.short_summary: Post-ceremony campus celebrations that extend Saint Mary’s Commencement day across the grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary’s reports that graduates and families took part in grad grounds traditions across campus after the 2025 Undergraduate Commencement ceremony.
cards.source_title: Saint Mary’s Undergraduate Commencement: A Vibrant Class of 2025 Charges into the Future, ‘Eyes Forward’
cards.access_notes: Available to commencement participants and guests; confirm current ceremony-day logistics with the College.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Mary's College of California, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A current Weekend of Welcome sequence that moves from settling in and meeting people to campus resources, recreation, and a closing community meal.

cards.title: Start with the Library Open House
cards.subtitle: Thursday afternoon · Saint Mary's College campus
cards.notes: Drop in after move-in to locate the library, ask a practical first-week question, and save the space for future study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A low-pressure first stop for finding a key campus resource.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a Library Open House during its 2026 Weekend of Welcome schedule.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 11:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Join the Welcome Liturgy
cards.subtitle: Thursday · Saint Mary's Chapel
cards.notes: If this form of gathering feels right for you, arrive a few minutes early and use the Chapel stop to orient yourself on campus.
cards.short_summary: An opening Weekend of Welcome gathering hosted by Mission & Ministry.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's schedules Welcome Liturgy, hosted by the Mission & Ministry Center, at the Chapel.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 3:00–4:30 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Eat at the Farewell BBQ
cards.subtitle: Thursday evening · Chapel Lawn
cards.notes: Use the meal as an easy conversation point: introduce yourself to someone nearby and compare notes on move-in and the next event.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled outdoor meal between arrival and the evening welcome activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a Farewell BBQ on Chapel Lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 4:30–7:00 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; confirm food accommodations with the College if needed.

cards.title: Make the Gael Welcome Walk your campus reset
cards.subtitle: Thursday evening · meet at the flagpole on Chapel Lawn
cards.notes: Meet at the designated flagpole, stay with your new-student group, and use the walk to learn a route you can repeat on foot.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled new-student walk that begins on Chapel Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's directs new students to meet at the Chapel Lawn flagpole for the Gael Welcome Walk.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: New students meet at 6:00 p.m.; the walk is listed at 6:30 p.m. Thursday, August 27, 2026.

cards.title: Close Thursday at Throwdown
cards.subtitle: Thursday night · Soda Center
cards.notes: Go with your hall or Weekend of Welcome leader, then confirm where and when your residence-hall social begins afterward.
cards.short_summary: An evening welcome event specifically listed for first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists the First Year Welcome Event, “Throwdown,” at the Soda Center.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed at 9:00 p.m. on Thursday, August 27, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Begin Friday at New Student Convocation
cards.subtitle: Friday morning · Chapel Lawn
cards.notes: Bring what you need for the day, arrive on time, and use the gathering as a clear handoff into Friday’s advising and community sessions.
cards.short_summary: A Friday-morning all-new-student gathering on Chapel Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists New Student Convocation on Chapel Lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 9:00–10:00 a.m. on Friday, August 28, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Try the Find Your People Involvement Fair
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · Dryden Hall
cards.notes: Make a short list of organizations you want to revisit, then ask how to join or where to find their next open meeting.
cards.short_summary: A first-year involvement fair for making connections beyond the residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's schedules the “Find Your People” Involvement Fair for new students in Dryden Hall.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed at 12:00 p.m. on Saturday, August 29, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Cool off at the Campus Recreation Pool Party
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring swim gear if you plan to participate, check the event details beforehand, and meet up with people you connected with at the fair.
cards.short_summary: A Campus Recreation social at the Alioto Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a pool party hosted by Campus Recreation at the Joseph L. Alioto Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 1:00–4:00 p.m. on Saturday, August 29, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: Add your mark at Paint the SMC
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · meet on De La Salle Lawn
cards.notes: Meet on De La Salle Lawn, follow the staff directions for materials, and treat this as a hands-on way to meet your cohort.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled creative group activity that begins on De La Salle Lawn.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists “Paint the SMC” with participants meeting on De La Salle Lawn.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed at 4:30 p.m. on Saturday, August 29, 2026; schedule is subject to change.

cards.title: End the weekend at the Welcome Back BBQ
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · De La Salle Lawn
cards.notes: Meet the people you want to see again during the week, swap contact details, and make a simple plan for your first class-day meal.
cards.short_summary: A Sunday evening meal that wraps the current Weekend of Welcome schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Mary's lists a Welcome Back BBQ on De La Salle Lawn during Weekend of Welcome.
cards.source_title: Weekend of Welcome | Saint Mary's College
cards.access_notes: Listed for 5:00–7:00 p.m. on Sunday, August 30, 2026; confirm dining details with the College.
